You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 5f7859c1cfaeeb1677075a72e36a0f0e8b05e9a8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Bj=C3=B6rn=20T=C3=B6pel?= <bjorn.topel@gmail.com>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2020 23:00:05 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] Documentation/features: Correct RISC-V kprobes support entry
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The Documentation/features/debug/kprobes/arch-support.txt incorrectly
states that RISC-V has kprobes support. This is not the case.

Note that entries that have been incorrectly marked with 'ok' will not
be changed back to 'TODO' by the features-refresh.sh script.

Fixes: 7156fc292850 ("Documentation/features: Refresh the arch support status files in place")
Signed-off-by: Björn Töpel <bjorn.topel@gmail.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200523210005.59140-1-bjorn.topel@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Corbet <corbet@lwn.net>

diff --git a/Documentation/features/debug/kprobes/arch-support.txt b/Documentation/features/debug/kprobes/arch-support.txt
index caa444a2a89f..8b316c6e03d4 100644
--- a/Documentation/features/debug/kprobes/arch-support.txt
+++ b/Documentation/features/debug/kprobes/arch-support.txt
@@ -23,7 +23,7 @@
     |    openrisc: | TODO |
     |      parisc: |  ok  |
     |     powerpc: |  ok  |
-    |       riscv: |  ok  |
+    |       riscv: | TODO |
     |        s390: |  ok  |
     |          sh: |  ok  |
     |       sparc: |  ok  |
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `Documentation/features/debug/kprobes/arch-support.txt`**
   - The entry for RISC-V was changed from `ok` to `TODO`. This indicates that RISC-V does not support kprobes, correcting the previous documentation.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in the `arch-support.txt` file directly addresses an inaccuracy in the documentation regarding RISC-V kprobes support. The change reflects a correction to the status of RISC-V, which was previously misrepresented as having support (`ok`). This update is part of a broader effort to ensure accurate documentation, as noted in the commit message referencing a previous commit that refreshed the arch support status files. The fix is necessary to prevent confusion and maintain the integrity of the documentation.

Based on your summary and the commit message in the patch, you need to:

1. analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 
2. output the file name that is most likely to cause the bug. 



Provide a response strictly in the following format:
Root cause:<Root cause>
file:<file name>

Based on the commit message, the root cause and the patch provided below, you need to:

1. explain how the bug occurs, including all code statements that are most likely to lead to the bug and why. 
2. explain how the bug is fixed, including code statements fixing the bug and why. 

You must include one or more code statements in point 1 and 2.
Code statements included in point 1 should be as brief as possible, only include the ones that are most related to the root cause and  the number of code statements may not exceed 3.


Here is the commit message:
Documentation/features: Correct RISC-V kprobes support entry
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The Documentation/features/debug/kprobes/arch-support.txt incorrectly
states that RISC-V has kprobes support. This is not the case.

Note that entries that have been incorrectly marked with 'ok' will not
be changed back to 'TODO' by the features-refresh.sh script.

Fixes: 7156fc292850 ("Documentation/features: Refresh the arch support status files in place")
Signed-off-by: Björn Töpel <bjorn.topel@gmail.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200523210005.59140-1-bjorn.topel@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Corbet <corbet@lwn.net>

Here is the root cause:
The root cause of the bug is the incorrect documentation entry that stated RISC-V has kprobes support, which is not the case. This misinformation could lead developers to believe that RISC-V architecture supports kprobes, potentially causing confusion and incorrect assumptions in development and debugging processes.

Here is the patch:
     |      parisc: |  ok  |
     |     powerpc: |  ok  |
-    |       riscv: |  ok  |
+    |       riscv: | TODO |
     |        s390: |  ok  |
     |          sh: |  ok  |

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```plaintext

```
Reason:
This line in the documentation incorrectly indicates that the RISC-V architecture has kprobes support by marking it as 'ok'. This misinformation can mislead developers into thinking that kprobes functionality is available for RISC-V, which is not true.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```plaintext
|       riscv: | TODO |
```
Reason:
Changing the status from 'ok' to 'TODO' correctly reflects that RISC-V does not support kprobes. This update clarifies the documentation, preventing confusion and ensuring that developers are aware of the actual capabilities of the RISC-V architecture regarding kprobes.
